title: studio: console noise from expected misses — ?state=draft probes 404, /layers 404, /ai/usage 501 polled without AI
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: every Studio surface open: `GET /api/v1/meta/<type>/<name>?state=draft` → 404 when there is no draft; `GET /api/v1/meta/<type>/<name>/layers` → 404 on new items; `GET /api/v1/ai/usage` → 501 (repeated) on a server without AI.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

Expected misses are probed as errors, so the console fills with red "Failed to load resource" lines that hide real failures during debugging.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Decide draft existence from the `/meta/_drafts` list Studio already reads (or have the server answer 200 + null); skip `/layers` for unsaved items; do not call `/ai/*` when discovery says AI is off.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *state=draft 404 layers 404 ai usage 501 console noise*: 0 hits (0 open, 0 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *studio ai usage endpoint 501 polled when AI not configured*: 4 hits (0 open, 4 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11736 (closed) — same polled-501-without-AI family, different surface
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11672 (closed) — noted 'Studio requests /api/v1/ai/usage and gets 501 on the open edition' as not filed
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: state=draft 404 probe · layers 404 · ai usage 501 polled · console noise studio
